summary: This 8-K reports the closing of a securitization transaction by Nissan Auto Receivables 2026-A Owner Trust, a special-purpose vehicle. On May 27, 2026, the trust issued asset-backed securities backed by a pool of retail auto loan receivables transferred from Nissan Motor Acceptance Company. The filing details standard sale, servicing, and asset representation review agreements, with no equity or control implications. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation event. No watch or arbitrage angle applicable.
